text: Auf dem See brach ein Sturm los. Die Wellen wurden gross und schwarz, und das Boot schwankte wild. Die Soldaten wussten nicht mehr, wohin. Einer von ihnen schrie: «Tell! Du kennst den See! Steuere uns!»
sceneDescription:
Roger — an adult man with shoulder-length wavy brown hair in a ponytail, brown eyes, clean-shaven, wearing dark-rimmed glasses, dressed in an earth-brown wool tunic with a leather jerkin and wool trousers — leaps mid-air from the right side of the flat wooden boat toward the flat grey rock of the Tellsplatte, his body extended in a wide forward leap, both feet tucked slightly, his head and torso at center-frame height, one hand gripping the forearm-length crossbow. The crossbow in his right hand is held roughly horizontal — its two short curved bow limbs mounted perpendicular to the wooden stock at the front end forming a T-shape, the slack gut bowstring visible across the limbs, the groove on top of the stock now empty. Roger faces left toward the rock, his body fully in the center frame with head at mid-frame, arms and body in the lower-center of the frame. The flat-topped grey rock of the Tellsplatte juts from the churning dark-green water in the left midground; white-capped waves crash at its base. The flat wooden boat is visible at the right of the frame, riding a large wave, tilting sharply. Soldier1 and Soldier2 — two adults in dark chain mail and leather armour — are visible inside the tilting boat at the right background, gripping the boat's sides. Heavy dark storm clouds fill the upper sky across the full top band of the frame. Rain streaks fall diagonally. The churning dark-green lake fills the lower half of the frame in every direction.
